in_marathi.name: Ekavira
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekavira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ekavira is derived from Sanskrit words 'Eka' meaning one and 'Vira' meaning a boat. This name is believed to signify the strength and protection provided by a single boat in the vast sea of life. It also symbolizes the journey of life and the importance of staying strong and focused in the midst of challenges.
